Spa Manager

Comis Hotel & Golf Resort is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Spa Manager to lead our spa operation and deliver an exceptional guest experience. This is a hands-on role combining spa management with treatment delivery.

Key responsibilities include managing daily spa operations, leading and developing the spa team, delivering treatments, overseeing bookings and rotas, driving retail and revenue performance, maintaining high presentation standards, and supporting the spa’s social media presence.

The ideal candidate will hold NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent), have previous spa supervisory or management experience, strong treatment skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for guest care and wellness. Knowledge of Elemis products would be an advantage.

The role requires flexibility, including weekends and busy operational periods.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary dependent on experience
• Staff benefits and hotel discounts
• Service charge participation
• Free onsite parking
• Training and development opportunities
• Supportive working environment within a growing resort

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to:
HR@comishotel.com

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Notes
Altenar is a leading sportsbook software provider delivering flexible, fully managed solutions to gaming operators globally. With a strong track record of growth and innovation, we operate at the intersection of technology and gaming.

We are looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join our in-house team with strong communication skills. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of legal matters, work closely with the business, and play a hands-on role in shaping how legal supports a growing international company. 

This position is suited to a proactive and detail-oriented lawyer who is comfortable working independently, taking accountability, and driving continuous improvement in legal processes and documentation.

Key responsibilities:

Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing, partnerships, and supplier contracts.
Act as a key legal contact for business stakeholders, providing clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused advice.
Take ownership of legal support for designated business areas.
Identify and implement improvements to legal processes, workflows, and ways of working.
Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance.
Collaborate with a multi-jurisdictional legal team.
Manage external counsel and support disputes where required.
Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments in the gaming and technology sectors.
Support strategic business initiatives, including new product development.

Skills & Experience:

4-6 years PQE (post qualification experience).
as a solicitor, advocate or equivalent required – this is a guideline so if you feel that you are suitable, please still apply.
Strong grounding in commercial and contract law. 
Experience in the gaming industry/software development industry is advantageous but not essential.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage priorities. 
Experience improving legal processes, templates, or ways of working is highly desirable. 
Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
Ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in a clear and concise manner.
Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across different jurisdictions and cultures.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and interest in the gaming/technology space.

Legal Technology & Innovation:

Experience working with legal technology tools (e.g. CLM systems, document automation) is advantageous.
Interest in leveraging AI and legal technology to improve legal service delivery and efficiency is desirable. 

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Discretionary bonus linked to performance.
Stable and flexible working environment.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
International, collaborative team environment.
Varied and  engaging work.

For more details and to apply contact job@altenar.com

Our client is seeking a Compliance Officer to support governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management across the business. Reporting to the eGaming Compliance Manager, the role involves overseeing client compliance obligations, ensuring regulatory deadlines are met, and identifying and escalating risks in line with Company procedures.
Key responsibilities include supporting gambling licence applications, onboarding, client reviews, SAR submissions, AML/CFT monitoring, and ensuring compliance with GSC returns and wider regulatory requirements. The role may also involve holding approved regulatory positions such as AML/CFT Compliance Officer and MLRO, while providing guidance to internal teams and clients on compliance matters.
You will assist with regulatory inspections, policy development, and maintaining strong relationships with regulators and stakeholders, while also mentoring junior team members and supporting team development.
The ideal candidate will have strong compliance experience, preferably within eGaming, financial services, or fiduciary services, with a solid understanding of AML/CFT legislation, Isle of Man regulatory requirements, and risk management. Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with a proactive and detail-focused approach. Knowledge of the operations and functions of a local authority.
Political sensitivity.

Notes
We are currently looking for a Senior New Business Administrator to join our Customer Services New Business Department.

Reporting to the New Business Manager, the role is responsible for overseeing and processing high risk and PEP applications ensuring all regulatory, AML/KYC, and company requirements are met across multiple jurisdictions. The role provides senior-level administrative support, acts as a point of escalation for complex or high risk cases, and supports the delivery of high service standards while contributing to process improvement.

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Review and quality-check documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with AML/KYC and multi-jurisdictional requirements.
Deliver accurate and timely administration of transactions, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and internal controls to maintain service integrity.
Maintain data quality and integrity across all systems by following established procedures and escalating discrepancies promptly.
Prioritize workload effectively to meet service level agreements and customer expectations, adapting to changing demands and deadlines.
Identify and escalate operational risks, errors, or breaches to safeguard compliance and prevent financial or reputational impact.
Support continuous improvement by suggesting process enhancements and participating in initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce risk.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve queries and deliver a seamless customer experience.
Keep up-to-date with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and best practice to ensure ongoing compliance and professional development.
Contribute to a positive team culture by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and promoting accountability and high standards.
Sign off Higher Risk Applications along with PEP, Complex & high value cases. 

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Extensive understanding of life assurance products and onboarding processes.
Strong knowledge of AM, CDD, FATCA & CRA along with offshore regulatory requirements.
Proven experience in a regulated financial services environment, processing and onboarding high risk new business applications adhering to regulatory frameworks.
Experience conducting enhanced due diligence checks and risk assessments for high risk, complex & politically exposed individuals.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in high-risk decision-making.
Ability to prioritize and manage complex workloads under pressure.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Title: Branch Colleague.

Reports To: Branch Manager.

Job Purpose:

To assist the manager in the day-to-day running of the branch.  Within this purpose the job holder will ensure the correct policies and procedures are complied with in line with company policy and practice, and ensure an excellent service is provided to all customers at all times.  The job holder will at all times promote the services of the company and always be looking to maximise both the sales and the profitability of the branch.  

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
	
Accept and carry out the requested service for customer shoe repairs, keys (including car fobs and other associated items), engraving and associated merchandise, watches including batteries, and offer the relevant associated advice all in accordance with the Company guidelines or custom and practice.  

Assist the Branch Manager in ensuring that high standards of housekeeping, maintenance, display, and stock management, including stockholding, ordering, usage, transfers and general branch organisation, are always maintained. 

Promote excellent customer service at all times.

Assist the Branch Manager to ensure that regular quality control checks are carried out reflecting suitably the standard set out by the Company.

Assist the Branch Manager to ensure the security of the branch and items left on the premises including cash, customer items, stock, fixtures and fittings including machinery.

In accordance with your Terms and Conditions of Employment, the employee should recognise that they are required to operate flexibly across a broad range of activities in support of the Company’s continuing need to adapt to change and to provide a first class service to its customers.

For more details and to apply contact alice.cribbin@timpson.com

Previous experience in a customer service role.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Team Manager

Join M&S as a Team Manager in Fashion, Home & Beauty, where you’ll lead from the front and play a critical role in reshaping our stores for the next generation of customers.

This isn’t a back-office leadership role. You’ll be on the shop floor, setting the pace, raising standards, and inspiring your team to deliver standout style, sharp service, and strong commercial results, even when the pressure is on.

We’re looking for confident, people-first leaders who thrive in fast-moving environments, make bold decisions, and know how to bring the best out of others.

What success looks like

A department that trades strongly, looks brilliant and delivers five-star service

A motivated, multiskilled team who feel supported, challenged and proud of what they deliver

Clear ownership of standards, safety, availability and operational excellence

Strong commercial results driven by insight, pace and great leadership

A culture where people feel valued, developed and excited to grow with M&S

What we’re looking for

Proven experience leading teams in a fast-paced retail or customer-focused environment

Strong commercial awareness with the confidence to use data and insight to drive results

The ability to coach, develop and performance-manage with clarity and empathy

Confidence having constructive, sometimes difficult conversations

A resilient, adaptable mindset with the energy to lead through change

Digital confidence and a willingness to embrace new ways of working

A natural role model for great service, inclusion and M&S behavior's

This is a role for leaders who don’t stand still. Who raise the bar, back their people, and take real pride in delivering results the right way. 

Are you ready for it? Take Your Marks and apply today.

Notes
We are looking for a reliable and proactive Multi-Skilled Operative to support the delivery of essential environmental and public works services across Ramsey Town. This varied, hands-on role includes street cleaning, litter collection, maintenance of parks, housing areas, beaches and public spaces, as well as assisting with signage, car parks, and general upkeep. You will also support refuse collection services, operate vehicles and equipment (training provided), and help ensure all areas are safe, clean and well maintained.
The role involves working outdoors in all conditions and contributing to key activities such as event set-up (including TT and seasonal events), additional cleaning and waste services, and responding to adverse weather by assisting with flooding, gritting, and safety measures. You will be expected to work safely at all times, carry out routine vehicle and equipment checks, and work collaboratively across teams as required.
The ideal candidate will be practical, flexible and team-oriented, with a strong work ethic and willingness to undertake a wide range of duties. A full, valid HGV driving licence is essential. 
We are seeking someone with experience in general labouring activities and safe working practices, who is physically fit and able to carry out manual tasks in all weather conditions. Strong communication skills, a good understanding of health and safety, and the ability to follow instructions are essential. Desirable qualifications include relevant certifications such as pesticide use and chainsaw operation, along with experience using machinery, tools, or driving plant equipment. A positive attitude, reliability, and the ability to work well within a team are key to success in this role.
For an information pack and application form, please contact HR@rtc.gov.im.  The closing date is Friday 29th May 2026.

Little Diamonds Nursery is looking for a caring, enthusiastic, and motivated individual to join our team as a Trainee Early Years Practitioner. Notes
We’re Hiring Part-Time Primary and Secondary Teachers.
Join our growing team at Kip McGrath Education Centres (Isle of Man).

We’re looking for passionate, qualified teachers who want to make a real difference.

We are currently hiring for multiple part-time roles:
Primary school teachers.
Secondary English teacher.
Secondary Maths teacher.
If you enjoy helping children build confidence, close learning gaps, and achieve real academic progress, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role:
At Kip McGrath, lessons are structured, focused, and designed to help students succeed in English and maths. You will work with small groups of students (max 4), delivering individualised teaching using our proven learning programmes and resources.

Our centres are fully managed, meaning you can focus on teaching while we take care of the administration, enrolments, and day-to-day logistics.

Why Work With Kip McGrath?
We know that great teachers do their best work when they are properly supported. Some of the benefits of joining our team include:

Competitive pay:
Students sourced and onboarded by our experienced centre managers.
Access to a world-class curriculum (online and paper-based).
Full access to high-quality teaching materials and lesson resources.
Structured programmes with clear learning pathways.
No take-home marking.
Supportive team environment across our Isle of Man centres.
Who we are looking for:
Primary and Secondary School Teachers (maths and/or English), who are:

Fully qualified (QTS)  – Mandatory requirement.
Passionate about education.
Enjoy working with children and building confidence.

Notes
Little Diamonds is seeking a dedicated, organised and passionate Cook to join our team, preparing nutritious meals for up to 100 children each day. This is a key role within our nursery, helping to support children’s health, wellbeing and development through high-quality food. At Little Diamonds, we believe that healthy eating plays an essential part in every child’s learning journey. We are looking for someone who shares our commitment to providing balanced, wholesome meals in a warm and caring environment. You will be responsible for planning, preparing and serving freshly cooked meals and snacks in line with children’s dietary needs, allergies and nutritional guidelines. You will work closely with the management team to ensure menus are varied, nutritious and compliant with current food safety standards. This is a busy role, requiring excellent organisation and the ability to work efficiently while maintaining the highest standards. The Ideal Candidate will have experience in a busy kitchen environment (nursery, school, care home or similar); a minimum of Level 2 Food Hygiene qualification; knowledge of children’s nutritional needs (desirable); strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently; a calm, positive and reliable approach and a genuine interest in supporting children’s wellbeing. If you are passionate about preparing nutritious food and would like to be part of the Little Diamonds team, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience to apply recruitment@littlediamonds-iom.net

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

About the Role:

We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Quality Engineer to join our Quality team. In this role, you will support the development, maintenance, and execution of quality plans, product specifications, and process control systems across new and existing products. You will work hands-on with manufacturing, engineering, and support teams to drive continuous improvement, enhance product quality, and reduce the risk of external escapes.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about quality, eager to grow, and excited to make a meaningful impact within a world-class manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop & maintain quality assurance and process control plans.
Analyse product, process, and measurement system capability.
Support PQP events, gage R&Rs, and validation for new products.
Train teams on quality tools, methods, and requirements.
Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.
What We’re Looking For:
Technical degree + 3+ years in quality, engineering, or manufacturing.
Experience with ISO 9001 or QMS auditing.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem?solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work cross?functionally.

Preferred Qualifications:
BS in Engineering or a Quality-related field.
Advanced problem-solving skills (DOE, Six Sigma).

We are seeking an experienced and motivated individual to lead our Arborist team and deliver a high-quality arboriculture service across the City. As Head Arborist, you will be responsible for managing a team of professionals undertaking a full range of arboricultural operations, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with industry standards. The role includes planning and programming work schedules, maintaining accurate records, liaising with stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with health and safety requirements.

The successful candidate will be an effective leader with strong communication and organisational skills and significant experience in arboriculture, including tree inspections, risk assessments, climbing, pruning, and the use of specialist equipment. Previous supervisory or management experience is essential. You must be computer literate and capable of managing operational documentation and reporting. The role requires a high level of physical fitness and a willingness to work outdoors in all weather conditions, as well as flexibility to work outside normal working hours when required. A full, clean driving licence and relevant certifications are essential.

A Relocation Package is available to assist successful off-Island applicant(s) relocating from the UK. 

To apply, please do so by completing an online application using the Job Train portal, which can be accessed by visiting: https://www.jobtrain.co.uk/douglascitycouncil/Job/JobDetail?JobId=110 - 

Please contact the HR Section if you require any further information: (hr@douglas.gov.im) or 01624 696455.

Notes
Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant (ACA) - ISLE OF MAN. 

About to Graduate? 
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:

EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026. 

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:

You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Skills and attributes for success:  Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:  2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Apply: Send CV & Cover Letter to Derek Ware at dware1@im.ey.com

Accountant – Business Doctor Limited (Isle of Man):
Business Doctor Limited is seeking a meticulous and experienced Accountant to join our team in the Isle of Man. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the financial operations for a diverse portfolio of businesses spanning the Isle of Man, South Africa, and Europe.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a chartered professional with international experience looking to apply their expertise in a dynamic, multi-jurisdictional environment.
 
The Role:
As our Accountant, you will take ownership of financial reporting and compliance across our various international entities. Your ability to navigate complex tax environments—specifically within the South African market—is critical to our continued success. This role includes the requirement for occasional international travel to support our operations in South Africa and Europe.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Maintain accurate financial records and prepare management accounts for companies in the Isle of Man, South Africa, and Europe.
Ensure full compliance with South African accounting practices and SARS regulations, including tax filings and reporting.
Coordinate with local authorities and partners in all operating jurisdictions.
Provide insightful financial analysis to support business decision-making.
Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll, and statutory requirements for assigned entities.
International Travel: Willingness and ability to travel internationally to our overseas office locations as required by business needs.
 
Requirements:
Chartered Accountant qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CA(SA), or equivalent).
Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of post-qualification experience.
Essential: In-depth knowledge of South African accounting standards and practical experience dealing with SARS.

About Us: 

Please apply here - https://careers.dandara.com/job/872551

At Dandara, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe the best ideas come from collaboration, and we’re passionate about creating a workplace where innovation, integrity, employee voice and customer focus thrive. By joining us, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team, driving meaningful change and helping to build vibrant communities.

The role: 

We are seeking a qualified accountant to join our central reporting team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, providing cover during a planned period of absence. This is an excellent opportunity to gain broad, hands-on experience across management accounting, group reporting, statutory accounts, and audit within a multi-jurisdictional construction environment.

Operating across the UK, Isle of Man, and Jersey, you will take ownership of core management accounting cycles while supporting group consolidation, statutory reporting, and external audit coordination. The role offers exposure to complex projects, cross-border entities, and senior stakeholders—ideal for someone looking to add value quickly while further developing their technical and commercial expertise.

What you will do:

Management Accounting:

Prepare monthly and quarterly management accounts across multiple entities.
Analyse variances (budget vs actual) and provide meaningful insights.
Perform intercompany reconciliations.
Ad-hoc Reporting & Analysis:

Develop dashboards and bespoke reports for Finance Business Partners and senior leadership.
Support reporting requirements including cash flow forecasting, covenant compliance, and KPI packs.
Statutory Reporting:

Prepare annual financial statements for UK, Isle of Man, and Jersey entities.
Audit Coordination:

Act as a key contact for external auditors.
Prepare PBC (Provided by Client) schedules, respond to queries, and track audit progress.
Support internal controls testing and remediation across jurisdictions.
Process & Controls Improvement.

Contribute to financial period-end processes and controls.
Support finance transformation initiatives, including rapid close and process optimisation.

What you will have:

Newly qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA (first-time passes preferred).
0–2 years’ post-qualified experience in audit, group reporting, or management accounting.
Strong technical knowledge of FRS102 and UK GAAP.
Exposure to construction or project-based accounting (e.g. WIP, percentage of completion) is desirable but not essential.
Advanced Excel skills (including PivotTables, Power Query, and complex formulas).
Familiarity with data/BI tools and an interest in leveraging digital or AI tools to improve reporting efficiency.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and deliver actionable insights.

Management Accounting:

Prepare monthly and quarterly management accounts across multiple entities.
Analyse variances (budget vs actual) and provide meaningful insights.
Perform intercompany reconciliations.
Ad-hoc Reporting & Analysis:

Develop dashboards and bespoke reports for Finance Business Partners and senior leadership.
Support reporting requirements including cash flow forecasting, covenant compliance, and KPI packs.
Statutory Reporting:

Prepare annual financial statements for UK, Isle of Man, and Jersey entities.
Audit Coordination:

Act as a key contact for external auditors.
Prepare PBC (Provided by Client) schedules, respond to queries, and track audit progress.
Support internal controls testing and remediation across jurisdictions.
Process & Controls Improvement.

Contribute to financial period-end processes and controls.
Support finance transformation initiatives, including rapid close and process optimisation.

Our client seeks a Client Accountant to join their team. In this role, you'll manage a diverse portfolio of entities, preparing financial statements and providing expert accounting services. Working with complex multi-currency transactions and sophisticated structures, you'll play a vital role in delivering exceptional client service while developing your expertise in this dynamic sector. Key Responsibilities: Manage the recording of financial information and preparation of financial statements for an allocated portfolio of entities. Maintain accurate day-to-day client ledgers, ensuring all transactions align with source documentation for complex multi-currency transactions. Keep up-to-date accounting records for client entities, paying attention to bank statements, agreements, invoices, and contracts. Liaise with the Administration Team on accounting queries and provide technical assistance as required. Prepare annual financial statements, solvency tests, asset statements, and other ad-hoc financial reporting. Prepare tax returns including UK property holdings with HMRC, IOM tax returns, and other relevant jurisdictional filings. Maintain awareness of changes to relevant financial, legal, and regulatory frameworks. Meet internal deadlines while maintaining high attention to detail and accuracy across all client financial records. Update accounts monitoring systems and maintain comprehensive documentation. Key Skills and Experience: A relevant qualification (e.g., ACCA) or minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role. Preferably fiduciary experience of accounting for company and trust structures. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written. Enquiring mind with ability to question, research, apply, and share learning. High level of accuracy, initiative, and exceptional organisational skills. Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel to intermediate or higher level. Ability to pick up and adapt to various bespoke IT/accounting systems and banking platforms. Excellent organisational skills and ability to meet tight deadlines. Ability to work under pressure and deal with complex issues proactively. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16509

Notes
Where You’ll Be: This programme is based in the Isle of Man. Please note that some travel between these locations and the UK may be required as part of the role.
Right to Work: Candidates must already hold the legal right to live and work in the the Isle of Man at the point of application.
Eligibility: You’ll have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a degree in any discipline by the time the programme starts.
Qualifications
Study for a relevant professional finance qualification such as Global Credit Certification (GCC) with the opportunity to take a further qualification in the second year of the programme.  Training and costs are all taken care of. 
At Lloyds Banking Group, we help businesses of every shape and size grow, thrive and prosper. From green finance to commercial lending, we’re supporting the economy at every level. 
 You won’t just hear about the big deals - you’ll be in the room, learning how they’re made, seeing the strategy unfold and being part of the action!
The Crown Dependencies business operates across Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man. We also have some colleagues based within the UK. 
 We serve Corporate, Wealth & Retail clients with a full banking proposition and a strong, local presence supported by the wider Group.
We’re growing fast and acting as a “bank within a bank” inside Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets.  With colleagues across the islands and the UK - all focused on delivering distinctive, locally relevant banking. 
 Two years. Four rotations - Unlimited Learning  
Over two years, you’ll take on four placements across our Crown Dependencies business giving graduates a rare, end-to-end exposure to banking – from building Client Relationships in our Fiduciary, Funds and Corporate & International Private Banking and Product Design to Risk Management.
You’ll undertake work that really matters, from managing client portfolios to analysing performance, supporting financial queries and driving the strategic direction for both the business and our clients. 
Closing date: 5 June 2026  
Start date: Mid-September 2026
What you need to apply - While we do not require a minimum degree achievement, we strongly recommend the ability to be able to demonstrate sound knowledge, understanding technical skills aligned to the role. 
Applications Our application process is designed to help you shine. We want everyone to feel they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture.

Find details, including stages and tips for success, on our how to apply page https://lbg.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/broadbean_external/job/Douglas-Villiers-House/Corporate-Banking-Graduate-Role--Crown-Dependencies_155325-3/apply

Are you an experienced administrator with a passion for pensions and customer service? Zurich International Life Limited is offering an excellent opportunity to join our Pensions team. As part of our dedicated team, you will provide administration services throughout the entire customer journey. This role will allow you to enhance your customer care skills through multi-tasking and critical thinking, ensuring both your work and that of the team are actively managed. You will thrive in both team settings and working independently, with a strong desire to understand the intricacies of our administrative processes.

 

You will be working to strict regulatory deadlines and must be able to communicate these effectively to our members, partners, and their advisors. Although training will be provided, you should be capable of managing your own development and daily work and be flexible enough to adapt to changing priorities quickly.

Notes
We are currently seeking a An Assistant Manager to join our busy General Accountancy Practice and Corporate Service Provider.
About the Role:
This role is ideal for a newly qualified accountant or someone with early post-qualification experience who is looking to broaden their expertise across general accountancy and trust services while developing managerial and leadership skills.
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee a small team of up to five staff, reporting directly to a manager and/or Director.
Oversee and reviewing preparation of Isle of Man payroll for clients.
Manage and maintain strong client relationships across a varied portfolio.
Oversee client engagements from both the general accountancy and trust services business.
Ensure timely preparation and review of financial statements.
Oversee and review taxation and VAT returns and associated assessments.
Be involved in the administration of client companies, varying widely in size and complexity.
Organise, co-ordinate, and allocate work for junior staff.
Review work completed by junior team members and to provide guidance and feedback.
Assist with the supervision, training, and development of junior staff.
Participate in staff appraisals, internal training sessions, and management meetings.
Maintain regular and effective communication with Managers and Directors with all relevant client matters.
Ensure clients comply with firm and regulatory requirements, liaising with the Compliance team regarding due diligence and KYC documentation.
Always Represent CM Partners and CM Trust professionally in a managerial capacity.

Minimum Education and Experience: 

Newly qualified ACCA or ACA, or up to two years’ post-qualification experience.
Practice trained would be beneficial.

Required Skills:
Strong communication and organisational skills.
Ability to lead, supervise, and develop junior members of staff.
High levels of discretion, diplomacy, and professional confidence.
Keen to broaden experience across all aspects of general accountancy and trust services for high-value clients.
Audit experience is not required.

Salary;
A competitive salary will be offered, based on qualifications and experience.
How to Apply:
For more information or to apply, please contact:
careers@cmiom.com

Assistant Greenkeeper – Seasonal.
Location: Comis Hotel & Golf Resort, Santon, Isle of Man.
Salary: Competitive, DOE.

Comis Hotel & Golf Resort is seeking a reliable and hardworking seasonable Assistant Greenkeeper to support the maintenance of our golf course, driving range, and resort grounds (approximately 200 acres).

Main Duties:

Assist with daily maintenance of the golf course and hotel grounds.
Operate grass-cutting and grounds machinery (training provided).
Follow safe working procedures and wear PPE.
Support seasonal maintenance schedules.
Work both independently and as part of a team.

This is a physical, outdoor role requiring good timekeeping, flexibility, and attention to detail.

No formal qualifications required. Knowledge of gardening, horticulture, golf, or basic mechanical skills would be an advantage. First Aid or Manual Handling training desirable (not essential).

Benefits: Competitive salary, staff discounts, duty meals, uniform, service charge participation, employee recognition schemes, and free parking.

To apply, please send your CV to HR@comishotel.com

Salary up to £75,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 plus Relocation Allowance up to £5,000.

Are you looking for an equine-focused role that offers genuine professional fulfilment alongside an exceptional quality of life? We’re delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our thriving practice on the beautiful Isle of Man. This is a varied and rewarding equine-only position, working within a supportive and experienced team where you’ll be encouraged to develop your clinical skills while enjoying a truly unique island lifestyle. For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Notes
Patient Care:

Greet and care for all patients within your care in a polite and courteous manner at all times.
Provide a comfortable, clean and uncluttered environment for patients.
Always be aware of patient confidentiality and data protection.
Inform reception of any reason for delays.
Ensure patients receive all necessary paperwork and that all forms are signed and dated correctly.
Be fully familiar with all emergency & evacuation procedures.
Promote a professional image of the company at all times.
The dental nurse must remain in surgery, ensuring that dentists are chaperoned at all times when treating a patient unless a clinical duty such as taking radiographs dictates.
Wear the correct clean uniform and maintain a professional appearance at all times while working with patients.
Maintain awareness of new developments and dental techniques.
People:
To work closely with the Team.
Provide support to dentists and other team members.
Encourage effective teamwork.
Liaise closely with reception to ensure maximum efficiency within their surgery.
Work closely with the dentist in a professional and appropriate manner.
Carry out reception and administrative tasks where required.
Assisting the dentists and hygienists at the practice.
Mentor and supervise all trainee dental nurses at the practice.
Conduct nurses meetings (monthly).
Conduct Practice Meetings (monthly).
Prepare the practice rota.
Clinical:
Assist the patient into surgery, settle them in the chair and prepare them for treatment.
Weekly spot checks to make sure surgeries are clean and stocked.
Perform the duties of infection control lead and ensure all staff are aware of and adhere to infection control procedures.
Clinically induct and supervise all new nurses in the practice.
Control clinical inventory and ordering of stock.
Ensure that all equipment faults are reported and actioned.
Immediately action any breach of cross infection controls or bad practice.
Environment:
Ensure waiting areas, corridors, stairs and immediate external areas are kept tidy and free of hazards in line with Health & Safety requirements.
Be vigilant and always action any problem or concerns.
Work experience and skills:
Ideal role for someone wanting Career Progression.
A friendly, courteous and welcoming disposition.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent telephone manner.
Experience of working within a surgery environment.
Undertakes CPD in line with GDC guidelines.

For more details and to apply contact sharon.newton@gensmile.co.uk

Are you a compassionate, enthusiastic person who genuinely cares about making a difference in people’s lives? 
We are looking for dedicated individuals to join our team of Care Support Workers, providing high-quality domiciliary care across the Isle of Man.
As the longest-standing care agency on the island, we pride ourselves on our strong reputation, supportive environment, and the wonderful relationships we’ve built with both our carers and clients.

What we’re looking for:

We are seeking true carers, people who are kind, reliable, and passionate about supporting others to live independently in their own homes. Experience is not essential, as full training will be provided, but the right attitude is everything.

Key requirements:

A caring and compassionate nature.
A positive attitude.
Commitment to delivering exceptional care.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Full, clean driving licence and access to own vehicle (essential due to island-wide clients).

What we offer:

Competitive rates of pay.
Paid holiday – rolled up holiday pay.
Mileage allowance.
Flexible working patterns – including day and night shifts.
Full paid training (no experience required).
Paid supervisions and ongoing support.
A welcoming, supportive team environment.

This is more than just a job, it’s an opportunity to make a real difference every day, helping people maintain their independence and dignity in the comfort of their own homes. If you have a genuine passion for caring and want to be part of a trusted, supportive team, we would love to hear from you.
Apply today and start a rewarding career in care.

For more details and to apply contact steve@completecare.im or 01624 674119.

Notes
We have an exciting job opportunity for a new team member in our beautiful, modern multidisciplinary
therapy clinic in the heart of Douglas. We are looking to recruit 1 x full-time or 2 x part time physiotherapists to join
our existing advanced therapy team to carry out a predominately MSK caseload of private and insurance funded work. 

We are looking for the right personality to fit in with the RehabLab ethos: with an interesting mixed
caseload of acute and chronic pain, sports injuries, orthopeadic and rheumatological rehab. The job can be
tailored to the clinical strengths and interests of the applicant due to widely diverse clinical caseload, outside
of MSK, including vestibular, paediatric, neurological, elderly and falls as well as women’s health physiotherapy and rehabilitation.

The successful applicants will be HPCP and CSP registered, hold BSc Physiotherapy degree or equivalent qualifying diploma, Disclosure Barring Service certificate, excellent communication skills, be enthusiastic for continued development and self-progression, be able to work some flexible hours (split days, evenings and/or weekends) and have the drive to develop and create more of their own caseload. Desirable criteria also include experience in manual therapy, exercise and strength and condition prescription, sports massage, Pilates, kinetic control method, sports team therapy, experience and certified in Acupuncture. Exciting training and development opportunities are available across this wider clinical caseload, for a committed team member.
Please email jobs@rehablabphysio.co.uk for more information (job description and specification) AND to submit your application which must consist of your CV and a covering letter to clarify why you are suitable for this role. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by 12.06.2026: after this date, if you have not heard from us please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

For more details and to apply contact jobs@rehablabphysio.co.uk

Notes
Doctor of Chiropractic – Full Time.
Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic, Douglas – Isle of Man.

Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic is looking for a friendly, professional, and motivated Doctor of Chiropractic to join our growing team on a full-time basis. This opportunity is suitable for both new graduates and experienced chiropractors who are passionate about delivering excellent client care and working within a supportive clinic environment.

We are a busy, established clinic based on the Isle of Man with a strong reputation for client-centred care, professionalism, and teamwork. Our clients range from babies to older adults, athletes, professionals, pregnancy and family care, with a focus on long-term health, wellbeing, and function.

This role is ideal for someone who is not only passionate about Chiropractic and delivering exceptional care, but also excited by the opportunity to help build and grow a clinic. The successful candidate must be willing to learn the skills involved in growing their client base, developing long-term relationships, contributing to the clinic culture, and becoming an active part of an expanding practice. An entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to learn about practice growth, communication, and client experience are highly valued.

We are looking for a chiropractor who is fully qualified, registered or eligible for registration to practise, and keen to continue developing both clinically and professionally. The successful candidate should have excellent communication skills, a caring and approachable manner, and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.

New graduates will benefit from mentorship and support, while experienced chiropractors will have the opportunity to grow within an established and respected practice. An interest in family care, wellness care, pregnancy, paediatrics, rehabilitation, or adjusting techniques would be advantageous, although not essential.

The role offers the opportunity to build a long-term career within a supportive and professional team environment. We value personal growth, integrity, and a genuine passion for helping people improve their quality of life.

To apply, please send:

Your CV.
A covering email.
A short introductory video.

Applications should be sent to Yvonne
e-mail: pm@evchiropractic.co.uk

Closing date for applications: 8th June 2026.

We are seeking compassionate, reliable, and dedicated Care Support Workers to join our growing domiciliary care team. This rewarding role involves providing high-quality, person-centred support to individuals within their own homes and supported living environments, helping them maintain independence, dignity, and quality of life.
Our services include dementia care, end-of-life care, supported living, learning disability support, companionship, and general daily living assistance. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a positive difference in the lives of vulnerable adults and committed to delivering respectful and personalised care.
Key Responsibilities:
Assist clients with personal care, hygiene, dressing, and mobility support.
Provide specialist support for individuals living with dementia, Alzheimer’s, and learning disabilities.
Support clients receiving end-of-life and palliative care with compassion and dignity.
Assist with medication administration in line with care plans and company policies.
Prepare meals and support nutritional needs.
Provide companionship and emotional support to promote wellbeing and reduce isolation.
Support with household tasks to maintain a safe and comfortable environment.
Assist clients in accessing the community, attending appointments, or social outings.
Follow safeguarding, health and safety, and infection control procedures at all times.
Respond appropriately in emergencies and provide basic first aid when required.
Skills & Experience:
Previous experience in domiciliary care, supported living, nursing homes, or similar care settings is desirable.
Experience supporting individuals with dementia, end-of-life care needs, or learning disabilities is advantageous.
Compassionate, patient, and professional approach to care.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Basic first aid knowledge is beneficial; training can be provided.
A valid driving licence is highly desirable due to the community-based nature of the role.

Notes
Key Tasks & Responsibilities:

1.	Continuously assess the needs of children, young people, and their parents; supporting a multi-agency approach to assessment and planning. 

2.	Ensure you have an understanding of, and comply with, Family Action’s procedures for promoting and safeguarding the welfare and safety of children and vulnerable adults, undertaking risk assessments and placing children at the centre of your work at all times.

3.	Work in a variety of settings, in particular the home environment, to develop realistic and achievable action plans, in consultation with children, young people and their parents, which are based on their assessed needs and written in a way that is easy for them to understand.

4.	Agree targets, in consultation parents and children, and monitor, evaluate and measure progress against them. Capture evidence of the distance travelled in terms of positive changes, using the Family Star (outcomes measurement tool). 

5.	Work with partner agencies to achieve improved outcomes for families. Communicating effectively; drafting and submitting reports to multi-agency meetings in a time manner; and working collaboratively with multi-agency professionals.

6.	Provide a range of support (both on a one-to-one basis and in groups), using various parenting programmes and evidence-based interventions, based on the needs of the family and the appropriateness of the intervention in line with those needs.

7.	Conduct yourself as an accountable professional; actively participating in supervision, training and appraisal processes and ensuring your knowledge, skills and practice is of a high standard.
8.	Maintain accurate and up to date case records in line with best practice, Family Action’s policies & procedures and our safeguarding standards.

9.	Attend, as required, a range of different multi-agency meetings and participate in, and actively contribute to, the development and delivery of multi-agency plans. Attend team meetings as required.

10.	Be responsive to challenge, advice, feedback and direction as part of your continuous development.
 
11.	Embrace and implement Family Action’s Equality & Diversity Policy in every aspect of your work and positively promote its principles amongst colleagues, service users and other members of the community.

12.	Comply with Family Action’s Health and Safety and Data Protection policies and protect your own and others’ health, safety and welfare.
 
13.	Work flexibly as may be required by the needs of the service and carry out any other reasonable duties as required.

For more details and to apply contact 01624 611568 or visit: https://internalcareers.family-action.org.uk/FamilyActionInternal/JobDescription/UbhLMLzLfuY

LV Home Care are looking for a Community Support Worker to join our lovely and dedicated team in the SOUTH to provide high quality domiciliary care for our clients. 
We are looking for enthusiastic, compassionate, respectful, honest and caring support workers with good communication and interpersonal skills. As a support 
worker you will support our clients remain in their own homes, assisting them with a variety of tasks such as personal care, medication administration, meal preparation, 
light household tasks, accompanying them to their appointments and shopping, welfare checks and companionship. We are committed to delivering the highest standards of 
person-centred care and striving for excellence to enrich the lives of our clients. Qualification and experience are preferred but not essential as full training will be given. 
Applicants must have full driver's license and have access to their own vehicle. An enhanced DBS check is required for this role which will be processed by LV once the 
position is offered, and accepted by successful applicant.
Competitive rates of pay, 4 weeks pro-­rata paid holiday and mileage pay on top of hourly rate. You will always have the support of management team 24/7. 
Successful applicant will be entitled to a sign­-on bonus. You will also be eligible to join the Company Pension Scheme plus Health Plan Entitlement after passing your 
probation period. At LV we work to empower our employees, so that they can achieve more. We ensure they have the freedom and resources to help them make 
a difference in the care industry. Come and join our very supportive and friendly team. Send your CV to homecareteam@lv.care or call 855382 if you would like 
to have an informal chat.

Notes
Are you a qualified and experienced massage therapist looking to join a professional, friendly chiropractic clinic team? Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic on the Isle of Man is looking for a motivated therapist to work within our established practice, helping support our clients’ health, recovery, and wellbeing in a collaborative environment.

We are particularly interested in therapists with experience or additional training in sports massage, pregnancy massage, or lymphatic drainage massage. An interest in learning more about chiropractic care and working alongside chiropractors is essential.

This role is based within our clinic, and the successful applicant will be treating and supporting clinic clients as part of the wider team. We are looking for someone professional, approachable, caring, and reliable, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for helping people.

The position will initially begin with one shift per week, with the opportunity to increase hours as demand grows. A minimum of six hours per week will be offered, with individual shifts no longer than five hours. Some flexibility with evenings or weekends may be required.

There is flexibility for the role to be offered on either an employed or self-employed basis, depending on the experience and preferences of the successful candidate.

Applicants should hold a minimum Level 3 qualification in Sports Massage Therapy or equivalent, along with valid professional insurance and a good understanding of anatomy and physiology. Experience in a clinical or healthcare setting would be advantageous.

In return, we offer a welcoming and supportive clinic environment, marketing support, opportunities for internal referrals, and the chance to grow within an established healthcare practice.

To apply, please contact Claire at Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic, Douglas with your CV and a short introductory video by e-mail: reception@evchiropractic.co.uk

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Care Manager to lead our growing domiciliary care service in Douglas. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated professional who is passionate about delivering high-quality, person-centred care and supporting individuals to live independently in their own homes.

The successful candidate will oversee the daily operations of the service, ensuring excellent standards of care, regulatory compliance, and effective staff management.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the day-to-day running of the domiciliary care service.
Ensure care is delivered in line with company policies, regulations, and best practice.

Carry out care assessments, reviews, and risk assessments.
Manage staff rotas and maintain appropriate staffing levels.

Supportive and friendly working environment.

Care Manager – Domiciliary Care Services.

Douglas, Isle of Man.
Full-Time | Permanent.
Competitive Salary (Dependent on Experience).

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Care Manager to lead our growing domiciliary care service in Douglas. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated professional who is passionate about delivering high-quality, person-centred care and supporting individuals to live independently in their own homes.

The successful candidate will oversee the daily operations of the service, ensuring excellent standards of care, regulatory compliance, and effective staff management.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the day-to-day running of the domiciliary care service.
Ensure care is delivered in line with company policies, regulations, and best practice.
Lead, supervise, and support care staff through training and performance management.
Carry out care assessments, reviews, and risk assessments.
Manage staff rotas and maintain appropriate staffing levels.
Build positive relationships with clients, families, healthcare professionals, and external agencies.
Ensure compliance with safeguarding, health & safety, and quality assurance requirements.
Support service development and continuous improvement initiatives.
Handle complaints, incidents, and service concerns professionally.

Requirements:
Previous experience in a senior role within health or social care.
Strong understanding of domiciliary care standards and regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organisational skills.
NVQ/QCF Level 5 in Health & Social Care, or willingness to work towards.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Full driving licence essential.
Enhanced DBS/police checks required.

What We Offer:
Competitive salary package.
Company vehicle.
Company mobile phone.
Fuel allowance.
Supportive and friendly working environment.
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

Join Woodbourne Dental, an established and highly regarded mixed practice on the Isle of Man. We are offering an exciting opportunity for an Associate Dentist to take over an existing, well-established patient list from our Principal Dentist, who is looking to move to a part-time oversight role. This transition promises a seamless handover and a steady flow of loyal patients, ensuring the new Associate can hit the ground running with a high potential for earnings.

Market-leading UDA rates, with up to 6,000 UDAs available.
Hand-over of the Principal Dentist's patients, providing an opportunity to hit the ground running with an established patient base.

A modern, fully digitised practice and state-of-the-art dental technology, including oral scanners.

Exceptional work-life balance in the Isle of Man, known for its stunning countryside, coastlines, and safe, vibrant community.

Notes
Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.

We are looking for an additional person to join our team who is bright, loves cooking and has a cheerful personality.

The job would be ideal for someone who is an experienced home cook who enjoys helping people and likes variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

This is a mixed role involving our kitchen and buffet food preparation, serving our lovely customers at lunchtimes and clearing after service.  Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 6.30 am to 2.45 pm (Mon – Fri), approx. 40 hours p.w. This is a Monday – Friday permanent role (i.e. non-seasonal & no split shifts).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be smart and clean in your appearance. Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please e-mail your CV to tastebuds@manx.net, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form and initial chat. If you would like to know more about the role, please telephone Andrew on 615516 after 2.00 pm. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, please assume your application has not been successful.

Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.

We are looking for an additional person to join our team who is bright, loves cooking and has a cheerful personality.

The job would be ideal for someone who is an experienced home cook who enjoys helping people and likes variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

This is a mixed role involving our kitchen and buffet food preparation, serving our lovely customers at lunchtimes and clearing after service.  Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 6.30 am to 2.45 pm (Mon – Fri), approx. 40 hours p.w. This is a Monday – Friday permanent role (i.e. non-seasonal & no split shifts).

You’ll be smart and clean in your appearance. Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please e-mail your CV to tastebuds@manx.net, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form and initial chat. If you would like to know more about the role, please telephone Andrew on 615516 after 2.00 pm. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, please assume your application has not been successful.

The Bar Worker is responsible for delivering friendly, efficient service to customers while preparing and serving drinks to company standards. The role supports a clean, safe, and welcoming pub environment.

We’re looking for friendly and reliable people to join our bar teams across various Heron & Brearley pubs on the island. We have roles available in both wet-led pubs and pubs that also serve food. No experience is needed as full training is provided. 

Applicants must be 18 or over due to alcohol service.

What the job involves:

Serving drinks and looking after customers.
Supporting food service where required.
Keeping the bar area clean and safe.
Handling payments and using tills.
Working as part of a team during busy shifts. 
Working hours. 

Shift work, including evenings and weekends. Hours vary by site.

What we’re looking for:

Friendly and approachable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Reliability and good timekeeping.
Ability to stay calm when it’s busy.
Willingness to learn and help out where needed. 
Training provided. 

You’ll receive full training in bar service, customer service, responsible alcohol service, and food hygiene where relevant.

Locations: 

Positions are available across multiple Heron & Brearley pubs around the Isle of Man.

To Apply follow this link: https://careers.hb.im/job/bar-worker-5843912?source=hb.im - Applications via email will not be accepted.

The Role:
We are looking for a dedicated and passionate Chef de Partie to join our kitchen team. You will be responsible for the smooth and efficient running of your section, ensuring food is produced to the highest standard while maintaining excellent hygiene, safety, and teamwork at all times.
This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated chef who takes pride in their work, enjoys developing others, and is committed to consistently high standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Ensure the efficient day to day operation of your assigned kitchen section.
Prepare mise en place and deliver food service for the restaurant and functions.
Produce dishes in line with agreed specifications, recipes, and presentation standards.
Maintain exceptional standards of food hygiene, cleanliness, and organisation.
Assist the Head Chef and Sous Chef with ordering and stock requirements.
Communicate effectively with senior chefs regarding food preparation and service.
Actively develop knowledge across menus and kitchen sections.
Complete all required food safety, hygiene, and health & safety documentation.
Follow HACCP procedures, cleaning schedules, and chemical usage guidelines.
Report equipment faults and maintenance issues promptly.
Attend required training and show flexibility with duties where needed.
Health, Safety & Compliance.
You will be expected to demonstrate a strong working knowledge of and compliance with:
Food hygiene regulations and HACCP policies.
Health & safety and fire regulations.
First aid procedures.
Kitchen cleaning and sanitation policies.
Company rules and procedures as set out in the Staff Handbook.
About You:
A reliable and professional chef with experience running a kitchen section.
Strong attention to detail and pride in personal presentation and hygiene.
Positive, team focused attitude with good communication skills.
Willing to develop, learn, and take on additional responsibilities.
Flexible and dependable, with a strong work ethic.
What We Offer:
A supportive and professional kitchen environment.
Opportunities for training and development.
Competitive pay (dependent on experience).
Staff uniform and meals on duty.
The chance to work within a well established hotel kitchen team.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@sleepwellhotels.com

Notes
Barista. 

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make your store the very best. 

Who you are?   We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and team player, who can strike up a good conversation. 

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, there are opportunities for development and progression within your store or one of our other stores on the Island, daily working hours (no late evenings), free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday, and recognition awards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

Notes
We are looking for a talented and motivated Sous Chef to join our team at the Falcon’s Nest Hotel. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced chef to take on a leadership role, supporting the kitchen team and stepping up to lead in the absence of the Head Chef.

We offer flexible working hours, a competitive salary, and the opportunity to work on exciting new menu developments and projects. As Sous Chef, you will lead and support the kitchen team, especially in the absence of the Head Chef, while working closely with the Culinary Manager to develop new menus for upcoming projects. You will ensure the kitchen runs smoothly and efficiently at all times, maintain high standards of cleanliness and organisation, and make sure all SFBB (Safer Food Better Business) practices are followed. 

We are looking for someone with proven experience in a busy kitchen environment, strong leadership and team management skills, and the ability to multitask and stay calm under pressure. Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards (SFBB) is essential, along with experience managing high-volume service, as we may operate multiple locations from one kitchen. 

If you are passionate about food, organised, and ready to take the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

For more details and to apply contact jamie@thenest.im

Our client seeks a Senior Technical Application Specialist to join their team. You will be the go-to technical expert, bridging Business, Operations and Engineering teams while leading complex analysis and solution design. This role offers the chance to champion low-code platforms, mentor colleagues, and shape technical strategy across the organisation. The ideal candidate will bring deep application expertise, a passion for automation and low-code innovation, and the confidence to lead technical direction across teams. Key Responsibilities: Act as the senior technical SME and trusted specialist for applications across the Group. Analyse complex business and customer problems and design fit-for-purpose technical solutions. Lead technical analysis, impact assessments and root cause investigations for incidents and change. Champion the use of enterprise tooling, low-code platforms and automation to improve outcomes. Evaluate, recommend and lead proofs of concept for new technologies, tools and methodologies. Oversee and support the implementation of complex technical solutions with expert guidance. Ensure specialist solutions align with Group technology direction through stakeholder engagement. Contribute to the development of technical strategy, standards and best practice. Mentor and coach colleagues, building technical capability and maturity. Foster innovation and influence future ways of working through thought leadership. Key Skills and Experience: Strong technical expertise across core banking and digital platforms. Experience with Internet Banking (.NET), iOS and Android mobile apps, Microsoft Dynamics 365. Proficiency with Power Platform and RPA tooling for automation solutions. Experience acting as an Application SME with deep understanding of system architecture. Knowledge of integrations, data flows, dependencies and system limitations. Experience designing event-driven data solutions and configuring Kafka topics. Proven ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs.Experience as the specialist for third-party SaaS and low-code tools driving adoption. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to recommend secure, scalable solutions. Experience modernising legacy technologies with supported enterprise solutions (desirable). Exposure to Java or Python in context of event streaming or API integration (desirable). Familiarity with data visualisation, dashboards or AI-enabled tooling (desirable). 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16530

Desirable (but not essential): Previous experience in an administrative or office-based role. Exposure to insurance or financial services. Notes
Our client seeks a Junior Credit Underwriter to support their Structured Finance Credit Team by assessing and analysing key financial and credit information and making recommendations for lending within the credit appetite and policy. Working within a supportive team environment, you'll gain exposure to sophisticated credit assessment processes while developing your expertise in this specialist area of finance. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with early credit or financial services experience who is eager to build deep technical underwriting expertise, develop strong analytical skills, and grow within a specialist structured finance environment. Key Responsibilities: Assess and analyse new and existing structured finance credit proposals, making recommendations based on financial and non-financial performance. Evaluate customer credit data and financial statements to determine lending risk levels. Analyse audited accounts, management information, forecast cashflow, and budget planners. Complete annual credit reviews of structured finance customers and recommend appropriate covenants and security structures. Monitor portfolio performance trends and escalate early warning indicators in line with policy. Complete quality assurance and sample testing against eligibility underwriting criteria. Assess and approve credit proposals within delegated authority limits. Analyse affordability measures, financial crime risks, and fraudulent applications. Key Skills & Experience: Experience within a similar role in banking or asset finance industries. Ability to analyse credit applications utilising financial statements, cashflow, and credit reference data. Understanding of UK & IOM regulatory requirements relating to credit facility provision. Strong knowledge of financial statements, ratios, and lending concepts. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with ability to influence at all levels. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Professional, detailed, and conscientious approach to work. Knowledge of block discounting, receivables assignment, and structured finance products (desirable but not essential). This is your chance to join a prestigious organisation that will invest in your professional development and provide a clear pathway to senior underwriting expertise. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16426
